claims.statement: For the matched physical form x dot y with one y=0 point defect, all ranks and affine phases satisfy U=I=r, H=2r, and G<=(5/2)I; the same constant holds for disjoint products.
The same 5/2 GU constant fails for all invertible bilinear matrices in fixed physical coordinates: at r=3, rows (111,101,011), a=111, b=0 give G/I>2.709116536420773.
limitations: This does not refute any larger dimension-independent constant
This is not an FEI counterexample
This does not affect the canonical matched-form theorem
